topics.title: Greedy Strategy
topics.task: Largest Sum: Read N, then N space-separated numbers. Greedily pick the top 3 largest numbers and print their sum. (Assume N >= 3).

topics.title: Coin Change Problem
topics.task: Read an integer Amount. Using Philippine coins (20, 10, 5, 1), greedily find the minimum number of coins needed to make exact change. Print the total coin count.

topics.title: Activity Selection
topics.task: Read N (number of events). Then read N start times on one line, and N end times on the next line. Print the maximum number of non-overlapping events you can schedule.
